newsitem.title: USA: Reader's Digest hires exec search firm-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Reader's Digest hires exec search firm-WSJ.

text.p: Reader's Digest Association Inc said it hired executive search firm SpencerStaurt to find a permanent replacement for former chairman and chief executive James Schadt, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The fact that Reader's Digest retained SpencerStaurt, which helped find Schadt, suggests the new CEO will again be recruited from outside the company, the paper said in its electronic edition on Friday.
In the wake of Schadt's departure earlier this week, former chief executive George Grune resumed the company's top posts in what Reader's Digest termed a "transition" move, according to the paper.
